_note: Illustrative specs from the project brief. max_rpm, regen_fade_rpm and the efficiency-map coefficients (c_load, c_speed) are modelling assumptions, not datasheet values.

PMSM.name: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
PMSM.note: High efficiency and power density; excellent regen at all speeds.

BLDC.name: Brushless DC Motor
BLDC.note: Simple trapezoidal control; good regen, lower power ceiling.

ACIM.name: AC Induction Motor
ACIM.note: Needs slip control to regenerate; wide speed range, no magnets.

SRM.name: Switched Reluctance Motor
SRM.note: Rugged and magnet-free; torque ripple and weaker low-speed regen.

DC Series.name: DC Series Motor
DC Series.note: Needs field/circuit reconfiguration to regenerate; brushes limit speed and efficiency.
